_doc: static-entity ids from cuwo. Located in the Crafting District (A) / around villages (S). Crafting menu key C shows required station.

anvil.name: Anvil
anvil.does: metal weapons, iron armor, fists, medium armors (X)

customization-bench.name: Customization Bench
customization-bench.does: attach material cubes (A+S) and spirit cubes (A) to weapons; rotate with M3, drag cubes

loom.name: Loom
loom.does: cloth armor (linen/cotton/silk); bows/crossbows also use yarn

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.does: wooden weapons: staves, wands, bows, crossbows, boomerangs, wooden maces; +12 wood cube upgrade (A)

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.does: cooking & alchemy marked campfire; thaw iceflower; standing in it does no damage

anywhere.name: No station
anywhere.does: water flask (in water), pineapple slice, snowberry mash, most potions/elixirs/beverages, rings & amulets
